sloka: अभिवार्य प्रहृष्टानि सर्वतः प्लवगेश्वरम् ।ततः प्रकृतयः सर्वा दृष्ट्वा हरि गण ईश्वरम् ॥४-२६-२०॥
transliteration: abhivārya prahṛṣṭāni sarvataḥ plavageśvaram ।tataḥ prakṛtayaḥ sarvā dṛṣṭvā hari gaṇa īśvaram ॥4-26-20॥

translations.english: Then all the subjects of the city collected together, prostrated to the chief of the monkey clan with their forehead touching the ground (as a mark of respect) and sat down.
